blurb: Crane Creek Vineyards is located in the Blue Ridge Mountains of North Georgia near Young Harris. Guests can visit two tasting rooms on the property offering wine tastings, wine by the glass, bottles, coffee, and snacks. The vineyard hosts live music, food trucks, festivals, and offers vacation rental accommodations on site.
